# Contact Form

A family of ready get-in-touch blocks on one recipe: ContactForm, LeadForm for sales, and SupportForm for help-desk requests. Each wires its controls through Field, owns its state and confirms on submit.

```tsx
<ContactForm onSubmit={(data) => send(data)} />
```

## Lead capture

`LeadForm` is the richer sales / collaboration block: a name and social row, a company-size Select, a country-aware [PhoneInput](https://koala-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/input.md), and a message. Drop it beside a hero to capture qualified leads.

```tsx
<LeadForm defaultCountry="ES" onSubmit={(data) => send(data)} />
```

## Support request

`SupportForm` is tuned for an inbound support queue: a name and email row, a support-topic Select, an optional order / reference field so an agent can pull the account up fast, and a message.

```tsx
<SupportForm onSubmit={(data) => openTicket(data)} />
```

## Installation

```bash
# One-time setup (tokens + lib helpers)
npx koalaui-cli init

# Add this component (its dependencies come along)
npx koalaui-cli add contact-form
```

Manual: run `npm install radix-ui tailwind-variants tailwind-merge`, then copy the source into `components/ui/contact-form/` and adjust the import paths to your project. Components pull `cn` from `lib/utils`, the `tv` wrapper from `lib/tv`, and (for multi-part components) `createContext` from `lib/create-context`.

## Usage

```tsx title="usage.tsx"
"use client"

import { ContactForm, type ContactFormData } from "@/components/ui/contact-form"

export function Example() {
  async function send(data: ContactFormData) {
    await fetch("/api/contact", { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify(data) })
  }

  return <ContactForm onSubmit={send} />
}
```

## API reference

### ContactForm / LeadForm / SupportForm

Each composes [Field](https://koala-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/field.md), [Input](https://koala-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/input.md), [Select](https://koala-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/select.md), and [Textarea](https://koala-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/textarea.md) (LeadForm adds [PhoneInput](https://koala-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/input.md)). Each forwards all `<div>` props.

- `onSubmit`: called with the block's data object on a valid submit ( `{ name, email, subject, message }` for ContactForm, `{ firstName, linkedin, email, companySize, phone, message }` for LeadForm, `{ name, email, topic, reference, message }` for SupportForm). Return a promise to drive the loading spinner.
- `variant`: `card` (default, standalone bordered block) or `bare` (drops the chrome to embed in a page shell).
- `density`: `compact` (16px padding, 32px fields, default) or `comfortable` (24px padding, 36px fields). The fields take the default control size for that density rather than the 40px a bare `Form` imposes, so the card stays proportional.
- `title`, `description`, `action`: override the default copy.
- `defaultCountry` (LeadForm only): initial ISO2 for the phone field.

## FAQ

### Which block should I reach for: ContactForm, LeadForm, or SupportForm?

Use ContactForm for an open-ended `get in touch` block (name, email, a general subject, and a message). Use LeadForm to capture qualified sales or collaboration leads: it adds a LinkedIn field, a company-size Select, and a country-aware phone field. Use SupportForm for an inbound support queue: it swaps in support-focused topics and an order / reference field. All three share one recipe and the same loading to success flow, so they feel identical to drop in.

### How do I embed a block inside a hero or marketing slab without the doubled card chrome?

Pass variant="bare" to drop the border, surface, shadow, max-width, and padding, so the block fills whatever shell hosts it. The card variant (the default) is the standalone bordered panel. It paints no fill of its own, so nested Inputs, Selects, and Textareas take the same ground the form sits on. The Contact marketing section composes LeadForm as a card floating over a photo.

### What shape is the data passed to onSubmit, and how do I drive the loading spinner?

onSubmit receives the block's typed data object (ContactFormData, LeadFormData, or SupportFormData). Return a promise from your handler and the submit Button shows its loading state until that promise resolves, after which the form swaps to the success panel, which renders with role="status" so it is announced to screen readers.

### How do I change the heading, supporting text, or submit button label?

Pass the title, description, and action props to override the defaults. Set description to null to drop the supporting line entirely.

### How does the family handle density and how do nested controls blend with the card?

The density prop accepts compact (16px padding, the default) or comfortable (24px), and falls back to the nearest DensityProvider when omitted. It also picks the field height: compact fields and the submit button are 32px, comfortable ones 36px, the same default size a bare control gets at that density. The block overrides the 40px a plain Form imposes, because a small card with tall fields reads as oversized. The card paints no fill of its own, so the nested Input, Select, PhoneInput, and Textarea take the same ground the form sits on instead of painting a mismatched block. Place it on a panel that declares --surface and they follow that panel.

## Exports and dependencies

`npx koalaui-cli add contact-form` writes `components/ui/contact-form/`. Import from `@/components/ui/contact-form`:

- Components and helpers: `ContactForm`, `LeadForm`, `SupportForm`, `contactFormVariants`
- Types: `ContactFormProps`, `ContactFormData`, `LeadFormProps`, `LeadFormData`, `SupportFormProps`, `SupportFormData`
- Koala components it installs with it: `button`, `field`, `form`, `input`, `select`, `textarea`
- Koala lib helpers it uses: `density`, `tv`
- npm packages: `@phosphor-icons/react`
